notes: Mirage: a strip whose cards draw a GROUND centres each card content in its own card; the row-line alignment is for a bare strip, where the cards have no edges. The CEO stacked pair was pulling its lower card content to the strip middle…

Row weights are applied, not just declared: writing position and size with cssText wiped the weight the piece was built with, so readout.css `.hero { font-weight: 600 }` drew every value bold. Each style write now carries the piece own…
